Do you want to work in a modern distribution center and are you legally allowed to work in the Netherlands? At Arvato in Echt, we are looking for logistics employees who enjoy staying active and contributing to a smooth warehouse process. Basic English is required, as you will work with English‑language systems and colleagues. Part‑time work is also possible, as long as you are available at least three full days per week. Keep on reading!

In this role, you make sure goods are processed quickly and accurately throughout the warehouse. Together with your team, you keep the logistics flow running efficiently.

What’s in it for you

    - Gross hourly wage of €14.99
    
- Temporary contract through Manpower
    
- Opportunity for a direct Arvato contract with good performance
    
- Travel allowance according to employer policy
    
- 32 to 40 hours per week, part‑time possible (minimum 3 full days)
    
- Additional allowances for shift work, overtime or adjusted shifts
    
- Pension accrual
    
- Working in a modern, automated logistics environment
    
- Time‑for‑time arrangement now applies

    - Good counting and basic math skills (scanner experience is an advantage)

Apply now through Manpower. After receiving your application, we will contact you as soon as possible.

As a CNC Portal Milling Operator in Ede, you work with the newest machines in plastic processing. You work full-time (40 hours) in two shifts: from 6:00 to 14:30 and from 14:30 to 23:00. Together with your team, you deliver high-quality products and enjoy a positive, open working atmosphere.
You program, set up, and operate CNC portal milling machines. You process plastic parts, from single pieces to series. You work with technical drawings and STEP files. You check dimensions and tolerances yourself. You discuss and implement optimizations with your team. You also carry out (preventive) maintenance on machines and tools. You work in a structured way and keep your workplace safe.
Every day is different! You get a lot of freedom and responsibility. You actively contribute to process improvements. You see the results of your craftsmanship right away. Want to work with modern machines and develop yourself further? Apply today! 😊

- MBO (secondary vocational education) working and thinking level, preferably in technology or machining
- At least 2 years of experience with CNC machines
- Experience with programming and reading technical drawings
- Experience with VectorCam
- You work accurately and have an eye for detail
- You actively contribute to improvements
- Team player and communicative
- You speak good Dutch and/or English

In Dordrecht, we are located at Burgemeester van der Dussenstraat 910. Here, we work with our Central Hub Manager Rob and approximately 200 colleagues. Every day, we process up to 200,000 packages here, which can be sorted to 150 locations. In any case, wherever you work: we *always* listen to what you have to say. The more perspectives and opinions we hear, the better we all become. For instance, as an organization, we received the Great Place to Work certificate this year. This certification is based 100% on employee feedback.

As a logistics employee at DHL, you help sort packages. You ensure that every package ends up in the right place. Without your help, the packages would not be sorted on time and would not be delivered to the customer on time.

You can start as a ‘packer’, where you place the packages on the conveyor belt so they can be sorted. You can start as a ‘packer’, where you take sorted packages off the conveyor belt and place them in a cart. Later, at DHL, you can also learn and perform other tasks in the warehouse.

Please note: a package can weigh a maximum of 25 kilos. Not every package is that heavy, but it can happen. You must always lift heavier packages together with a colleague.

Working hours/shifts vary between 17:00 and 02:00.

- You are available for at least 4 days a week between 17:00 and 02:00;
- You can lift packages weighing up to a maximum of 25 kilos;
- You have your own transport (car, bicycle, scooter, or you live within walking distance);
- You speak Dutch or English so that you can communicate well with your team.
- You are at least 18 years old.
- Residing in the area of Dordrecht / Rotterdam / Schiedam / Capelle aan den IJssel

READY TO TAKE YOUR WAREHOUSE SKILLS TO THE NEXT LEVEL?

Are you an experienced warehouse worker and confident operating warehouse equipment? Join DHL Supply Chain in Weert as an EPT, OPT, Reachtruck or Forklift Driver!

- Full-time availability – You are available for 40 hours per week. Shifts from 06:00 - 15:00 & 15:00 - 00:00, rotating weekly.
- Relevant experience – Experience with EPT, OPT, reachtruck or forklift work is preferred.
- Certificate – A valid certificate for the equipment you operate is a plus.
- Own transportation – You can independently travel to and from work.
- English skills – You can communicate in English at work.
- Safety-minded & reliable – You work carefully, take responsibility and follow safety instructions.
- Team player – You enjoy working together with colleagues to get the job done.

Do you enjoy staying active and working in a logistics environment where no two days are the same?

DHL Supply Chain in Beringe is looking for a Logistics Employee – Day Shift for the Schneider Electric department. Together with your colleagues, you will ensure that orders are processed accurately and delivered on time.

Your responsibilities will include order picking, packing, loading and unloading goods, checking and sorting products, processing incoming shipments, and storing goods in the correct warehouse locations.

You will be part of a dynamic and international working environment with a wide variety of tasks. DHL offers thorough onboarding, excellent growth opportunities, and regularly organizes fun extras such as staff parties, food trucks, and team events.

- Good command of the English language
- Experience in logistics
- Ability to work with computer systems and Microsoft Excel
- Flexible and motivated attitude
- Own transportation
- EPT, forklift and/or reach truck certificates are an advantage

You will be working in an international team in a warm atmosphere. GXO celebrates succeses, so don't be surprised if they hand out icecreams during summer time, or a cake for someones birthday. Are you creative enough to source parts that almost no one else can find?

As a Purchasing Officer, you are responsible for sourcing all required parts for a single aircraft, from A to Z. This is not a role focused on routine purchasing or recurring orders. Your challenge is to track down critical aircraft parts when the source is unknown, supply is limited, or availability is extremely scarce. For you, "impossible" is not an option. If a manufacturer cannot deliver a part for several months, you proactively explore alternative solutions; for example, by creatively reallocating components from other aircraft undergoing maintenance.

You will work closely with a multidisciplinary team of B1 Licensed Aircraft Engineers, B2 Avionics Engineers, and the Planning Department to ensure maintenance projects stay on schedule. In addition, you will meet with clients once or twice a week to provide updates on part availability and sourcing progress. This role requires persistence, creativity, strong communication skills, and the ability to think beyond conventional procurement methods to keep aircraft flying.

- MBO+/associate degree level of thinking and working; eagerness to learn matters more than your diploma

- Experience purchasing technical parts or raw materials is a plus

Are you looking for a friendly workplace in Leeuwarden where helpful colleagues always stand by your side? Join our team as a production worker at Rentex! Here you earn a solid wage up to €15,89 gross per hour. From day one, your dedicated Tempo-Team contact person and warm team members will guide you step-by-step through every routine. Want clear answers and zero stress? Then this is your vacancy, more information below!

What we offer
- A starting salary of €14.99 per hour!
- Complimentary fresh soup and fruit provided daily!
- Shift allowances of 22.5% and 45%
- Opportunities for career advancement!
- A good travel allowance!
- Meaningful work that directly supports hospitals!

Who you are
As a production worker, you appreciate a welcoming workplace with clear structure and good communication. To start smoothly at Rentex in Leeuwarden, you meet the following requirements:

- You speak and understand English or Dutch;
- You are available for at least two days a week;
- You are available for shifts starting at 06:00 or 15:00;
- You have your own transportation to travel to Rentex;
- You are at least 18 years old, in accordance with labor laws regarding these specific working hours;

What will you do
As a production worker clean laundry at Rentex, your work is structured, predictable, and very important! Together with your team, you process clean linens and uniforms for hospitals across the Netherlands. You help sort fresh textiles, feed clean laundry into automatic folding machines, and hang garments onto scanning racks. Never done this before? No worries at all! Patient buddies will coach you on every task until you feel 100% confident. You work steady shifts between 06:00 and 23:00, and your supervisors are always nearby to answer your questions.
